queries.name: latest_complete_month_totals
queries.purpose: Show the headline performance for the latest complete month with the core revenue, units, transactions, price, basket size and basket value measures.
queries.intent: Grand totals for [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], filtered to 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[DOC_MONTH] = 12 and with matching month context propagated through the active KEY relationships to CAT_TRANSACTIONS, one row. This is the report headline period because the model is monthly and the latest complete month is month 12.

queries.name: full_year_grand_totals_with_levers
queries.purpose: Provide the full-year background totals and three-lever summary for the whole business.
queries.intent: Grand totals for [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], no filters, one row. Use this as the full-year comparator behind the latest-month headline; do not duplicate the already-fetched baseline query structure beyond this explicit summary request.

queries.name: monthly_trend_by_doc_month
queries.purpose: Show how the core measures moved across the 12 trading months, with the most recent month first.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[DOC_MONTH] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return up to 12 rows, sorted by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[DOC_MONTH] DESC.

queries.name: branch_revenue_units_breakdown
queries.purpose: Compare branch performance using only measures that are reliable at branch level.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[LOC_CODE] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], and [QTY GROWTH %]. Return all available branch rows up to 15 rows, sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC. Do not include [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], or [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] here because branch-level transaction-based measures are not reliable for this model.

queries.name: department_performance_breakdown
queries.purpose: Show which departments are largest and how each department changed on revenue, units and transaction growth.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[DEPARTMENT] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return up to 15 rows, sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC.

queries.name: section_performance_breakdown
queries.purpose: Show the main sections driving the business and their revenue, units and transaction-growth patterns.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[SECTION] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return up to 15 rows, sorted by [net revenue CURRENT] DESC.

queries.name: category_top_current_revenue
queries.purpose: Identify the biggest current-revenue categories and their current versus prior performance.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[CATEGORY_NAME] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return the top 15 rows by [net revenue CURRENT] descending.

queries.name: category_top_and_bottom_revenue_change
queries.purpose: Identify the categories with the largest revenue gains and losses for focused commentary.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[CATEGORY_NAME] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Produce the paired tails by taking the top 7 rows by [revenue Growth] descending and the top 7 rows by [revenue Growth] ascending, for a maximum of 14 distinct rows, with final sort by [revenue Growth] DESC.

queries.name: brand_top_revenue_breakdown
queries.purpose: Add a brand view from the brand table to show which brands are largest in current revenue.
queries.intent: Summarize by 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[BRAND_NAME] and return [REV_CURRENT], [REV_PREV], and [Percentage]. Return the top 15 rows by [REV_CURRENT] descending. Use the brand table’s own revenue measures because brand exists only on 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB' and should not be crossed with 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2' dimensions in the same breakdown.
